description: This file defines the GatewayProcessManager class, responsible for managing the lifecycle, environment, and connectivity of a gateway process within the application. It includes state management, logging, connection handling, start/stop operations, environment refresh, and integration with system launch agents.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class for managing the gateway process, including startup, shutdown, status monitoring, and logging.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets whether the gateway process should be active, handling remote mode constraints and triggering environment refresh, start, or stop accordingly.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and enables the launch agent for the gateway if necessary, respecting remote mode and launch agent write disable flags.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates starting the gateway process if it is desired and not already running, attempting to attach to existing instances before launching a new one.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process, disables relevant launch agents, and resets status and related details.

methods.name: clearLastFailure
methods.description: Clears the last failure reason log.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the environment status, respecting minimum interval unless forced.

methods.name: refreshLog
methods.description: Refreshes the gateway log from the log file.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to connect to an already running gateway on the configured port to avoid spawning a new process.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for a discovered port or instance, including health or process details.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly message for failures during attachment to an existing gateway.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates a gateway authentication failure.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Enables the launchd service for the gateway, waiting for the gateway to start and verifying success.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends text to the in-memory log buffer, trimming if size exceeds limit.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel connection if it is disconnected or degraded.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for the gateway to become ready within a timeout.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the log buffer and deletes the log file.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path in the CommandResolver.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Retrieves the current project root path from CommandResolver.

methods.name: readGatewayLog
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of the gateway log file, limited to a character count.
